items.title: The Xreal Aura are an impressive first step for Android XR glasses
items.excerpt: TechRadar's full review of the Xreal Aura, the first glasses-form Android XR device, calls it a versatile on-your-face computer and lists useful Gemini integration among its strengths.

items.title: Google's Xreal Aura, Reviewed: The Weird Evolution of VR Into Glasses Is Already Underway
items.excerpt: CNET reviews the $1,099 Xreal Aura Android XR glasses with Gemini built in, scoring it 7.0 and calling it the most fascinating and frustrating device it has used in a long time.

items.title: Xreal Aura Review: Android XR combined with lightweight glasses delivers a true next-gen spatial computing experience
items.excerpt: Xreal Aura pairs lightweight glasses with a puck running Qualcomm's Snapdragon Reality Elite platform (48 TOPS of AI compute) and ships a controller with a dedicated Google Gemini button.

items.title: Samsung's next TV may watch you and pause movies when you leave the couch
items.excerpt: Samsung's next AI TV, expected at CES 2027, reportedly uses AI to recognize viewers' movements, pausing when someone leaves the couch and resuming when they return, plus on-screen item lookup and shopping.

items.title: Gemini for Home is botching simple Spotify requests
items.excerpt: Users report Gemini for Home on Google's smart speakers and displays is misunderstanding Spotify requests, playing the wrong tracks and unrelated artists.

items.title: Google confirms huge list of new Home features, including three Nest Thermostat upgrades
items.excerpt: Google says Gemini for Home is now about 20% faster on everyday requests and has expanded to six more countries including India, Taiwan and Singapore, alongside new Nest Thermostat upgrades.

items.title: I tried the Flowtica Verso AI notetaker expecting a gimmick - now it's my new favorite MagSafe gadget
items.excerpt: ZDNET reviews the Flowtica Verso, a MagSafe AI recorder with an e-paper screen that snaps onto a phone and turns recorded conversations into transcripts, summaries and action items.

items.title: Apple's buggy HomeView launch is making Google Home look good
items.excerpt: Early reviews of Apple's HomeView smart home hub describe unfinished software, with Siri AI problems that make even Google Home look good by comparison.

items.title: Apple Reportedly Finalizes Smart Glasses Hardware, Puts Siri at Strategic Center
items.excerpt: Bloomberg reports Apple's N50 smart glasses hardware is largely finalized ahead of a WWDC 2026 unveil next June, with Siri AI at the center of the software experience.

items.title: Apple's first smart glasses are coming together
items.excerpt: Apple's Siri AI-powered eyewear is set to be announced at WWDC next year; The Verge rounds up what's known about the hardware and how Siri will drive apps on the glasses.

items.title: Some Places Have Already Banned AI Glasses, And The List Just Keeps Growing
items.excerpt: Safety and privacy concerns have led courtrooms, schools, theaters and other public places to ban AI glasses, and the list keeps growing as camera-equipped AI eyewear spreads.

items.title: National top scorer in Korea admits to AI cheating on notoriously tough tax exam
items.excerpt: After scoring 397.5 out of 400 on South Korea's tax accountant exam, the top candidate confessed he used a microcamera and generative AI to get the answers.

items.title: 'AI 안경 의혹' 세무사 수석 합격자, 결국 부정행위 자수… "진짜 수석에 죄송"
items.excerpt: 제63회 세무사 시험에서 AI 스마트안경 부정행위 의혹을 받은 수석 합격자가 전자기기와 생성형 AI를 이용해 시험을 치렀다고 인정하고 경찰에 자수했다.

items.title: AI 안경 사태에 "인도가 앞서갔네"…10년 전 '팬티바람 시험' 재조명
items.excerpt: 세무사 시험 AI 안경 부정행위가 드러나면서 첨단 전자기기를 악용한 부정행위 대책 논의가 커지고, 응시자 속옷 시험을 치른 인도 사례가 재조명되고 있다.

items.title: I Tested Apple Intelligence on a Top New Security Camera to Find Its Limits
items.excerpt: CNET tests Apple Intelligence's AI video descriptions for security cameras on the Aqara G350 to see whether the feature is worth it.

items.title: The Apple Watch Can Record and Rewind Spoken Conversations Now. It's Pretty Awkward
items.excerpt: Apple Watch's Live Rewind and Siri Recap transcribe missed moments and summarize your day with AI, though WIRED found the wrist-worn recording socially clumsy.

items.title: Microsoft Ignite 2026: Building Windows for the next era of work
items.excerpt: At Ignite 2026 Microsoft details Windows features for AI agents, including 'Hybrid Intelligence' that splits AI work between on-device and cloud models, with controls over what agents can access.
